title: Choose the visual world for Gvozdi
question: Safer hand, steered by you: the growing plant leads Home, the logo stays, small and familiar.

options.label: Herbarium Sheet
options.lineage: School herbarium sheets: a pressed specimen on a mount with a typed label
options.thesis: Your practice as a living specimen mounted on Home, labelled like a herbarium sheet.
options.viewport: Logo top left; the plant mounted large in the first card with a corner label (No. 30 · sapling · 3 days); today's practice below with a green Begin; the week as a strip of small leaf marks.
options.risk: Close to Botanical Folio by design; needs the cool mount white, not cream, to read as new.

options.label: Greenhouse at Dawn
options.lineage: A windowsill greenhouse at first light, the hour most people step on the board
options.thesis: Home is the plant on the sill before sunrise: deep green, a pale glowing plant, one warm light for Begin.
options.viewport: Logo top left in pale ink; the plant glowing on a dark green ground across the top half; today's practice on a slightly lighter pane with a warm amber Begin; the week as seven small panes.
options.risk: Dark-first; light mode needs its own careful daylight version or it looks like an afterthought.

options.label: Linocut Plant
options.lineage: Folk linocut and lubok prints: carved line, two flat inks
options.thesis: The plant carved as a block print, growing one cut at a time; everything else is quiet two-ink print.
options.viewport: Logo top left; a bold carved plant in black and green beside a big streak number; today's practice below with a black Begin; the red berry marks today only.
options.risk: Carved art must be drawn well at every stage; a clumsy cut reads as clip-art.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: Executed like Forest and Finch: a clean white app where one growing tree is the reward.
canonCard.viewport: Large title, a centred tree on a soft disc, streak under it, a wide green Begin, the week below.
canonCard.risk: Looks like every growth-habit app; Gvozdi's board-specific craft disappears.
